title: TV producer's master tape lost on his death

tellings.quote: the guy that gave it to Chuck Clark was a TV producer in Los Angeles

plain: The documentary filmmaker James Fox says that a man named Chuck Clark got a piece of footage from a TV producer in Los Angeles, and that the original master tape, on a professional broadcast videotape format called Beta SP, was lost when the producer died. Fox tells it from his own pursuit of the footage, which would matter because the best copy of whatever it showed is now gone.
